## About Me

I am a student at the University of Texas at Austin. I have a major in Russian, Eastern European and Eurasian Studies and a minor in Statistics and Data Science. Other interests of mine include oceanography, languages and history. I love watching movies, often Soviet or Russian movies, and going to football games.
